node.title: Re^4: Migrating from Windows Server 2003
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Thanks for the info. It [http://matrix.cpantesters.org/?dist=GD%202.56|looks like] some older versions of GD indeed did have some trouble, at least with their tests. [matro] [id://1218871|made] a good point too: Strawberry Perl ships with GD, as far back as [http://strawberryperl.com/release-notes/5.8.9.4.html|5.8.9.4], with GD 2.44.
